Groups of [[Grawl Longspear]]s can be found throughout [[Pre-Searing]] Ascalon and some seem to have survived through the [[Searing]] and can be found in [[Post-Searing]] Ascalon as part of the quest [[The Stolen Artifact]]. They are often found in groups of three with at least one [[Grawl Shaman]], especially in [[The Northlands]].
